layout.hierarchy: The neural network diagram dominates visually due to its large size and red border. The 'Example' title is next most prominent in large red text. Green formula boxes stand out on the right. Body text uses black, blue, and red for emphasis.

visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network diagram inside a red rectangular border. Input layer on left: black dot labeled x₁ with value (1), black dot labeled x₂ with value (5), blue dot labeled Bias with circled 1. Hidden layer center: three yellow circles labeled 3, 4, 5. Output layer right: two orange circles labeled 6, 7. Directed edges connect all inputs to all hidden nodes and all hidden nodes to all outputs, plus bias connections. Edge weights are labeled in green (input-to-hidden), red (hidden-to-output), and blue (bias connections). Labels 'Input' above left, 'Output' above center-right, 'Target' above far right. 'η=5' in red at bottom-right of diagram border.
visual_elements.position: top-center to middle-right, roughly x=18% to x=90%, y=10% to y=46%

visual_elements.description: Wider white rectangular box with thin black border containing two lines of red calculation text for Net₆ and Net₇.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. 'Example' is large, bold, red, title case at top-left. 'Forward' is medium blue bold. Calculation text uses red for variable names (Net, O) and black for numbers and operators. Subscripts are used (Net₃, O₃, t₆, etc.). Node labels are black numbers inside colored circles. Slide number '27' is black text inside yellow circle.
animation_state: No obvious mid-build animation visible; all elements appear static.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray-beige (#E8E4D8). 2. Add title 'Example' in large bold red (#C00000) at top-left. 3. Add yellow circle with '27' at top-right. 4. Draw a large red-bordered rectangle for the neural network diagram spanning top-center to mid-right. 5. Inside diagram: place black dot x₁ with (1) below it on far left; black dot x₂ with (5) below it; blue dot Bias with circled 1 below x₂. 6. Place three yellow circles labeled 3, 4, 5 in center column. 7. Place two orange circles labeled 6, 7 on right side. 8. Draw directed edges from all inputs to all hidden nodes and all hidden to all outputs, plus bias edges. Label weights: input-to-hidden in green (0.1, 0.2, 0.3 from x1; 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 from x2; 0.1, 0.1, 0.1 from Bias), hidden-to-output in red (0.3, 0.4 from node 3; 0.4, 0.5 from node 4; 0.5, 0.2 from node 5), bias-to-output in blue (0.2, 0.2). 9. Add labels 'Input' above left, 'Output' above center-right, 'Target' above far right. 10. Add O₃ above node 3, O₄ above node 4, O₅ above node 5, O₆ right of node 6, O₇ right of node 7. 11. Add target column (0) t₆ and (1) t₇ at far right. 12. Add 'η=5' in red at bottom-right of diagram border. 13. Below diagram left, add blue bold 'Forward' header. 14. Add white box with black border containing three red lines: Net₃ = 1*0.1+5*0.4+1*0.1 = 2.2; Net₄ = 1*0.2+5*0.5+1*0.1 = 2.8; Net₅ = 1*0.3+5*0.6+1*0.1 = 3.4. 15. Add wider white box below containing two red lines: Net₆ = 0.9*0.3+0.943*0.4+0.968*0.5+1*0.2 = 1.3312; Net₇ = 0.9*0.3+0.943*0.4+0.968*0.5+1*0.2 = 1.3312. 16. On right side, stack five light green boxes with dark green borders containing: O₃ = 1/(1+e^-2.2) = 0.9; O₄ = 1/(1+e^-2.8) = 0.943; O₅ = 1/(1+e^-3.4) = 0.968; O₆ = 1/(1+e^-1.3312) = 0.791; O₇ = 1/(1+e^-1.3312) = 0.791.
